bio: Luigi (Aloysius) was baptized on Christmas Day 1795, son of Giovanni Colosimo and Teresa Cicco ([R4-S1]). He married Carmela Moraca, daughter of the late Alessio, on 29 January 1818 ([R4-S2]). He was buried on 14 April 1864, a fortnight after his wife ([R4-S3]).
